summary: Completed comprehensive analysis of critical user workflows for E2E testing. Identified 10 critical paths across the Auto-Claude-Marketing frontend application, including Roadmap Generation, Task Creation, Project Management, Settings, GitHub Integration, Issues Management, Terminals, Kanban Board, Onboarding, and Task Execution. Each path includes detailed step-by-step flows, happy path/error case/edge case scenarios, test approach recommendations with tool selection (Playwright vs Electron MCP), and priority levels (4 P0, 5 P1, 1 P2). Created implementation roadmap spanning 6 weeks across 3 phases, with infrastructure recommendations including test data strategy and CI/CD integration.
current_status: Critical paths analysis complete. Document saved with 60 total test scenarios across 10 critical paths. All files analyzed include App.tsx, TaskCreationWizard.tsx, Roadmap.tsx, AddProjectModal.tsx, AppSettings.tsx, GitHubIssues.tsx, GitHubSetupModal.tsx, and Terminal.tsx.
